audit.auditor: implementing coding agent; no human or external peer review claimed
findings: All 32 proposals are mechanically valid. Natural: eight evaluator passes, sixteen genuine failures.
T exactly separates natural and eager labels in this finite sample; no public-pass wrong natural proposal.
Graph variant 3 fails through unguarded recursion on undirected cycles; runner classifies a real candidate exception.
Correct API wrappers retain provider-defined original indices; D invents index renumbering.
Correct RLE and directed reachability are falsely rejected or UNKNOWN by reviews.
The eager eight have two correct proposals, exactly the same task IDs correct under ordinary prompting.
Private references/expected values are absent from staged file inventories and model request fields.
audit.scope: Policy-blind contract/code/counterexample audit before scoring; fixed IDs plus all cases, no relabeling.

revisions.pilot: One readable multiline task interface after contract-copying and repeated-source pilot defects; six fresh roots, unchanged caps and economics.
